title: Seaside Serenity | 2 Bedrooms - 30A Five Star Properties
description_expanded:
🌊 Sterling Reef — 17th Floor Gulf-Front 2BR Retreat

2 BR • 2 BA • Sleeps 6 • Panoramic Gulf Views

✨ Highlights 🏖 Complimentary seasonal beach chair service included (March–October) — 2 chairs + umbrella set up daily so you can relax and enjoy the beach with ease 🌊 Oceanfront corner layout with incredible natural light and panoramic Gulf views 🪟 Floor-to-ceiling windows showcasing sweeping Gulf views and stunning sunsets 🌅 Oversized private balcony accessible from both the living room & primary suite — perfect for morning coffee or evening cocktails 🛏 Spacious King primary suite with private ensuite bath 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Second bedroom with two full beds and adjoining bathroom — ideal for families or groups 🏊 Resort-style heated bi-level pool, fitness center, and sky terrace with BBQ grills 🚗 Garage parking included 📶 High-speed WiFi for streaming, working remotely, or staying connected 🏡 The Space Experience stunning 17th-floor views in this bright and airy 2BR condo designed for comfort and relaxation. Perfect for families and small groups, the open layout, natural light, and floor-to-ceiling windows bring the coast right to your living room. Step onto the oversized balcony for uninterrupted sunsets over the Gulf and the pier.

🛏️ Sleeping Arrangements • Primary Suite: King bed • balcony access • private bathroom • Bedroom 2: Two full beds • adjoining bath

🌴 Amenities • Heated bi-level pool with waterfall • Gulf-view fitness center • Sky BBQ terrace • Beach rentals & water sports onsite

📍 Location • Next to Bay County Fishing Pier • Across from Shipwreck Island Waterpark • Close to restaurants, shopping & St. Andrews State Park

🚗 Parking The HOA requires a $50 one-time parking fee per car (virtual registration). Park anywhere not marked “Do Not Park.”

📅 Off-Season Ask about quiet-season specials—we’d love to host you!
